Thank you all for the advice, unfortunately the UK also does not issue a 'single' status document either so im not sure where to go from here! I dont think the hungarian one will count for much since im only a resident and not a citizen. Im going to go the route of arguing + affidavit regarding this document + possibly a notarised and apostilled declaration that im not married to anybody else. 

This seems like such a silly document to provide if im already married and its already registered in Israel 😅 gahhh, thank you all so much!
